services.desc: The last few days we have been on the coho salmon. We caught a total of 34 Fish the last two trips. Despite the cooler weather in the rough seas our customers toughed it out and got their limit. We have been fishing North of Milwaukee Where we found a packet of water temps 53 degrees. Milwaukee offshore fishing is on fire right now So it might be a good time to book a trip. We will be uploading some photos to our social media accounts soon but for now I have to go to bed because I’m Getting up at 4:00 again To get out on the water Wish us

blurb: Guests fish for king salmon, coho salmon, lake trout, rainbow trout (steelhead), and brown trout on Lake Michigan. Trips are offered on four quality boats with high-tech equipment and premium tackle. Fish are filleted and bagged onboard for guest convenience.
extraNote: Fish rain or shine except lightning or hazardous conditions · Strict cancellation policy: cancel within 60 days before trip to avoid charges; within 45 days for groups 7+ or multi-day trips requires 60 days notice or full charge applies · Deposit held and applied to rescheduled trip under extreme unforeseen circumstances · Credit card and Venmo payments incur 4% fee; cash preferred · McKinley Marina, park in the first lot to the right or on the east side wall next to the boat ramp; meet captain at the roundhouse (octagon shaped building with white roof)
